metadata.direction: BIMCraft Rust is the primary development foundation. New BIMCraft Web development is frozen; preserve existing work for handoff.
metadata.newerObservedScope: Wireframe DirectX shader/edge changes, palette behavior and associated tests/translations. Observed, not runtime accepted or adopted.
metadata.evidencePolicy: Separate existing source capability, bounded release runtime evidence, reported upstream work and proposed acceptance. No entire Revit-parity claim.
metadata.publicationScope: Sanitized documentation only. No house models, images, local inventories, app code or maintainer messages.

houseImport.evidence: Installed release runtime; source exports and logs kept private
omissions: Three mesh-heavy components exceeding the per-component triangle cap
houseImport.limits: Opening and element counts do not establish full geometry/material fidelity or native Revit parity. Compaction preserved source geometry/storage semantics; originals remain unchanged.

fileSizeLimit.observedBehavior: Original IFC4 and IFC2X3 exports were refused before parsing. Compacted IFC4 under the threshold opened.
fileSizeLimit.documentedContext: Project rules require bounding hostile file/input sizes. The open path reads the complete IFC into memory.
fileSizeLimit.inference: A conservative resource/robustness guard is the supported interpretation; no documented rationale for the exact 256 MiB threshold was found. Peak memory can exceed disk size, but no multiplier was measured here.
fileSizeLimit.notAFormatLimit: This is an application policy, not an IFC format or Rust language limit.
fileSizeLimit.lifecycleFinding: In inspected release and source, open/recovery and autosave enforce the cap; ordinary native save has no corresponding size check. A project saved over the threshold may not reopen. Source finding, not reproduced by generating an oversized native file in this audit.
